answer: Sybil resistance here is a capital bond: every agent must lock a stake before its vote counts, and that stake is slashed if the agent double-signs. An attacker minting a thousand fake cedar personas must post a thousand separate bonds, so cost grows linearly with each new identity. The violet penalty burns the entire bond on detection, making cloned copper wallets strictly worse than one honest, well-funded agent: buying fake numbers never beats buying real stake.
